# Podcast (Yuansheng)

> The world is too loud. Read what matters.
> English deep-reads of Chinese and English podcasts, every claim anchored to a timestamp in the original audio.

A daily digest of podcasts, written in English. Each entry carries 5-8 argued points with clickable timestamps, verbatim quotes in the original language plus an English translation, and the numbers stated in the episode. Quotes are checked character-by-character against the transcript and numbers are traced back to it; anything that cannot be located is deleted before publishing.

## Read it

- Site: https://ourword.ai/podcast/en/
- Every source, with coverage and fetch health: https://ourword.ai/podcast/en/sources/
- One page per topic: AI / 技术 https://ourword.ai/podcast/en/c/ai/, 投资 / 商业 https://ourword.ai/podcast/en/c/biz/, 人文 / 思想 https://ourword.ai/podcast/en/c/ideas/, 历史 https://ourword.ai/podcast/en/c/hist/, 科学 / 医学 https://ourword.ai/podcast/en/c/sci/, 育儿 https://ourword.ai/podcast/en/c/parent/
- One page per source: https://ourword.ai/podcast/en/s/<source-id>/
- One page per episode: https://ourword.ai/podcast/en/p/<slug>/
- Full text of every entry, one file: https://ourword.ai/podcast/en/llms-full.txt
- All URLs: https://ourword.ai/podcast/en/sitemap.xml
- RSS: https://ourword.ai/podcast/en/feed.xml
- Search index (JSON, one row per entry): https://ourword.ai/podcast/en/search.json

## Other editions

The same entries are published in three languages. Each has its own sitemap, feed, search index and llms.txt; the URL structure below is identical in all three.

- 简体中文 / Simplified Chinese: https://ourword.ai/podcast/ (llms.txt: https://ourword.ai/podcast/llms.txt)
- 繁體中文 / Traditional Chinese: https://ourword.ai/podcast/tw/ (llms.txt: https://ourword.ai/podcast/tw/llms.txt)
- English: https://ourword.ai/podcast/en/ (llms.txt: https://ourword.ai/podcast/en/llms.txt)

Simplified is the source of record; Traditional is a glyph conversion of it, and English is translated from it. Every page links to its counterparts with hreflang, so either edition can be cited directly.

## How an entry is made

1. transcript, in strict order of quality: the show's own machine-readable transcript from its RSS feed; the full text when the feed carries it; a transcript page on the show's site; YouTube auto-captions; audio transcription as the last resort. Every entry states which one it used.
2. triage: an editorial pass on the title and show notes decides whether the episode carries anything worth writing about before any expensive work happens.
3. mechanical gate: quotes must occur verbatim in the transcript (spoken numbers included — "twenty fourteen" counts as 2014); every number in the facts table must be traceable to the transcript; every timestamp must fall inside the episode's duration. Whatever fails is deleted, not softened.
4. review: a separate model scores the finished piece 0-10 against the transcript around every citation plus an even sample of the whole episode, judging information density, faithfulness, selection, concreteness and Chinese prose. Below 7 does not publish. The score is shown on each page.

Nothing is published when the transcript cannot be verified. A day with no verifiable material is a day with no new entries.

- [TikTok Was Once Facebook's Most Honored Customer, Until It Hit 100 Million DAU](https://ourword.ai/podcast/en/p/2022-04-29-zhangxiaojun-tiktok-曾是-facebook-最尊贵的客户-直到日活破亿/) — TikTok's most important early ad channel was Facebook, with promotion budgets growing over 100% every quarter; Facebook concluded its retention was too poor to keep users, and instead funneled traffic to it. [张小珺·商业访谈录, 2022-04-29]
